column1: # Every query-level setting of chDB 26.9.0 (ClickHouse 26.9.2.1), as
# `SELECT name, alias_for FROM system.settings ORDER BY name` prints them: a
# name, then a tab and the setting it is an alias for, if it is one. The worker
# pins every setting not on loams_house_ipc::policy's lists (HS1 R-ACL.1);
# `the_settings_list_follows_chdb` fails when the pinned chDB has another list.
